metadata.title: STOPP-relevant UK medicines dataset
metadata.purpose: Contextual medicine-name matching layer for a static medication review website. This file is intended to support STOPP-relevant prompts during medication review and should not be used as an automatic prescribing rule engine.

primaryReferences.title: STOPP/START criteria for potentially inappropriate prescribing in older people: version 3

notes: Many STOPP criteria depend on duration, indication, renal function, falls history, heart failure, constipation, delirium risk, and other clinical context.
A matched medicine should therefore be displayed as STOPP-relevant with context to review, not as an automatic breach.
